company.name: Center for a New American Security

profile_text.body:
The Center for a New American Security, or CNAS, is a nonprofit organization founded in 2007 and headquartered in Washington, DC. On its own site it describes its work as developing strong, pragmatic and principled national security and defense policies.

Its published material covers artificial intelligence as a national security subject. CNAS says it launched the Sovereign AI Index to track every government-backed sovereign AI project since 2023, projects it describes as seeking to improve a country's AI self-reliance. The site also carries commentary on the steady progress of AI systems and forecasts about artificial general intelligence, on a model called Kimi K3 that identified itself as Claude, Anthropic's model, and on reaction to a Hugging Face incident followed by the release of a model that is harder to monitor.

The record holds no lawsuits involving the organization, no AI products tracked under its name, and no MCP servers. As a nonprofit, it has no securities filings in the material.
